title: Airship Island
safeHtml:
'''Airship Island''' is the largest natural island in Los Sengas. At the time of its existence, its District Number was 21. It is located to the southwest of Peckern, the northwest of Twenty-Second Continent, the southwest of West Metropolis Archipelago and the northeast of Centopia. On May 4 2022 this island was split into Peckern and Twenty-Second Districts, but the entire island became a part of Peckern on May 6 2023.

Location

Airship Island is located to the southwest of Peckern Continent and the northwest of Twenty-Second Continent. While this island is the largest natural island in Los Sengas, it does not belong to West Metropolis Archipelago.

Transport

Facilities

Currently, Airship Island is home to a bus terminus, a street terminal and other basic road connections. Moreover, this island is also one of the candidates for the location of Los Sengas University. However, despite being the confirmed location of the university, the university is still under construction as of yet. Moreover, roads connecting to Kioku Island of Centopia were built on September 18 2023.

Description

is one of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It passes through TriPaw, Jupiter and Twenty-Second Continent.

This line is represented by Fuchsia on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 30.

Currently, this route is 28.1 km long, with a total of 21 stations.

Development Plans and History

Development Plans

  • Since November 2019, TriPaw and Twenty-Second Continent have seen drastic development and rapid surges in population. As of June 2020, population in Twenty-Second has reached 310 thousand, with 180 thousand of them having no access to rail transport and has to rely entirely on road transport. This causes severe traffic problems in the Twenty-Second Continent.
  • To alleviate Traffic congestions, the developer of Twenty-Second Continent and TriPaw has submitted a proposal to Nazca and suggested a new Standard Railway line on Nazca Railway that starts from station, and passes through , Mount Galileo and , before proceeding to Diamond Pool, Halozy and Craneplaz in Twenty-Second Continent and ending in .
  • While this proposal was initially accepted by Nazca Railway, if the line starting from has to pass through , the line would have to make an extremely large detour just in TriPaw alone before reaching . As a result, the terminus of this line has been moved to , and the section between and was replaced by to alleviate transport needs in that area.

Description

is one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. The line starts from Centopia, and skirts the north-western edge of Twenty-Second Continent before passing through West Metropolis Archipelago and stopping in Downtown. Afterwards, it passes through north Katadelphia and Zootuary before arriving in Internal Sea.

This line is represented by Milky Red Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number A.

Currently, this line is 32.855 km long, with a total of 6 stations.

  • The section near integrates with the ecological properties of the vicinities, and due to the fact that it passes through Zootuary, the speed of the train is also slowed down to reduce noise pollution. As a result, this Veloduct has the lowest operational speed near Zootuary, at just 30 km/h.
  • The section between and used to have the longest inter-station distance in Los Sengas Division at 12.43 km. However, in S3E2, this record is broken by when the section between and began operations at 13.02 km. However, this section still holds the longest inter-station distance for Veloducts.
  • Parts of this line shares tracks with and .
  • This line is the only Veloduct that has a permanent terminus at ().
  • Among the lines stopping at Metropolis Terminal, this line is the only line that does not use it as the "Zero Station".
  • Centopia is constructed in an artificial island.
  • The train arrival announcements of this line allude to East Rail Line of Mass Transit Railway.
